method: Both latent arms start from the same pretrained autoencoder and train the PBSLM trunk and the role and position tags. The joint arm also trains the encoder and decoder and receives full-phrase reconstruction cross-entropy in addition to task cross-entropy.
limitations: Synthetic relation task, frozen random source token embeddings, one offset-4 split, and fake int4 quantization with FP32 tensors. The historical 800-step frozen control accidentally disabled tag gradients.

provenance.limitation: dirty status is explicit; hashes identify exact selected sources; GPU bitwise determinism not promised
